drowzee-future-sight.name: Future Sight
drowzee-future-sight.description: Bond skill: a foreseen psychic blast at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 100).

drowzee-calm-mind.name: Calm Mind
drowzee-calm-mind.description: Bond skill: calms its mind, becoming Focused and Fortified for 2 turns.

drowzee-zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
drowzee-zen-headbutt.description: Bond skill: a headbutt charged with willpower (Power 90, Attack).

drowzee-swinging-pendulum.name: Swinging Pendulum
drowzee-swinging-pendulum.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

drowzee-dream-hunger.name: Dream Hunger
drowzee-dream-hunger.description: Deals 25% more damage to sleeping foes.

drowzee-poison-gas.name: Poison Gas
drowzee-poison-gas.description: New skill: gas around a foe up to 1 hex away, Poisoning those hit for 2 turns.

drowzee-headbutt.name: Headbutt
drowzee-headbutt.description: New skill: rams its head into a foe (Power 60), Slowing it for 1 turn.

drowzee-clear-mind.name: Clear Mind
drowzee-clear-mind.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

drowzee-dream-feast.name: Dream Feast
drowzee-dream-feast.description: Heals 20% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

drowzee-psyshock.name: Psyshock
drowzee-psyshock.description: New skill: a psychic wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70).

drowzee-disable.name: Disable
drowzee-disable.description: New skill: a hypnotic gesture at a foe up to 2 hexes away Paralyzes it for 1 turn.

drowzee-unshaken.name: Unshaken
drowzee-unshaken.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

drowzee-mind-games.name: Mind Games
drowzee-mind-games.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes with any status.

drowzee-psywave.name: Psywave
drowzee-psywave.description: New skill: an eerie psychic wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 45), Cursing it 2 turns.

drowzee-mega-punch.name: Mega Punch
drowzee-mega-punch.description: New skill: a powerful punch at an adjacent foe (Power 85).

drowzee-spreading-drowsiness.name: Spreading Drowsiness
drowzee-spreading-drowsiness.description: When a foe it afflicted faints, adjacent foes catch that status.

drowzee-restful-mind.name: Restful Mind
drowzee-restful-mind.description: Heals 5% of max HP at the start of each turn.

drowzee-hyper-beam.name: Hyper Beam
drowzee-hyper-beam.description: New skill: a devastating beam at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

drowzee-body-slam.name: Body Slam
drowzee-body-slam.description: New skill: slams its body into a foe (Power 85), Paralyzing it for 1 turn.

drowzee-hypnotic-rhythm.name: Hypnotic Rhythm
drowzee-hypnotic-rhythm.description: The team gains 1 Bond when it lands a combo.

drowzee-hypnotic-hold.name: Hypnotic Hold
drowzee-hypnotic-hold.description: Foes it engages take 15% more damage from its allies.

drowzee-grand-hypnotist.name: Grand Hypnotist
drowzee-grand-hypnotist.description: Capstone. Its non-damaging skills recharge 1 turn faster; its statuses last 1 turn longer.

drowzee-dream-devourer.name: Dream Devourer
drowzee-dream-devourer.description: Capstone. Knockouts reset its skill cooldowns; takes 15% less damage.
